unsure.package.json: backend and deploy: carries the protocol pins and the build scripts, but also the deploy, proof and release scripts
unsure.README.md: backend and deploy: the public face of the project, but it describes release pins and deployment
unsure.AGENTS.md: backend and deploy: agent rules apply to both
unsure.rules/: backend and deploy: agent rules apply to both
unsure.doc/adr/: backend and deploy: AGENTS.md points at the tenets ADR; the other ADRs mix product and deployment
unsure.packages/control-plane/wrangler.jsonc: backend: wrangler dev and the tests need it, but it carries stage names and the dev D1 id (scrubbed); the stage RFC may move the stage parts to infra
unsure.packages/dashboard-site/: backend: generic worker code, but its wrangler config names the dev and prod stages
unsure.npm-scripts/release-fetch.mjs: backend: the integration tests fetch pinned releases with it, but it reads release-pins.json, which stays in deploy
unsure.npm-scripts/release-download.mjs: backend: shared by release-fetch and surface, reads release-pins.json
unsure.npm-scripts/surface.mjs: backend: writes doc/surface.md from the pinned CLI release
unsure..devcontainer/: backend: a contributor environment, but it may follow the deploy prebuild
unsure..github/workflows/checks.yml: deploy: the brief puts every workflow in deploy, but backend and infra need their own checks
unsure.packages/infra-worker/: infra: its wrangler config names a dev worker
unsure.crates/, typespec/, packages/api/, packa: dropped everywhere: already extracted to tumpel/supervisor, tumpel/cli, tumpel/protocol and tumpel/dashboard
